user.title: Weather Conditions
user.description: Choose how this instance gets its weather data.

weather_entity.title: Existing weather entity
weather_entity.description: Pick the weather entity to base the current-conditions card and MagicMirror feed on. Forecast support varies by integration — if hourly/daily stay empty afterwards, check Developer Tools → Actions → weather.get_forecasts against this entity.

openweathermap.title: OpenWeatherMap One Call 3.0
openweathermap.description: Polls OpenWeatherMap directly for a guaranteed-complete feature set (current, hourly, daily, alerts, minutely nowcast, UV, moon data) independent of which weather.* entities Home Assistant happens to have. Needs a free OpenWeatherMap API key with One Call 3.0 enabled — openweathermap.org requires a card on file even for the free 1,000 calls/day tier, but a 5-minute poll interval only uses ~288 calls/day.

data.owm_latitude: Latitude (defaults to your Home Assistant location)
data.owm_longitude: Longitude (defaults to your Home Assistant location)

abort.already_configured: This weather source is already configured.

init.title: Weather Conditions options
init.description: Optional supplemental sensors and alert thresholds.

data.uv_index_entity: UV index sensor (optional, overrides the weather entity's own UV if set)
data.soil_forecast_entities: Soil-temperature forecast sensors, one per line, day 0 first (each holding a bracketed CSV of hourly values)
data.uv_at_or_above: High UV alert at or above index
